NAME.label: Name cross-check
NAME.mitigant: Obtain affidavit / one-and-same-person declaration; correct manual bureau record; recommend basis justification.

PARENT_NAME.label: Parent name cross-check
PARENT_NAME.mitigant: Confirm the co-applicant is the applicant's parent; obtain relationship proof / one-and-same-person declaration.

DOB.label: Date of birth cross-check
DOB.mitigant: Obtain affidavit / one-and-same-person declaration; correct manual bureau record; recommend basis justification.

FATHER_NAME.label: Father name cross-check
FATHER_NAME.mitigant: Clarify the father's name; obtain one-and-same-person declaration if needed.

MOTHER_NAME.label: Mother name cross-check
MOTHER_NAME.mitigant: Clarify the mother's name; obtain one-and-same-person declaration if needed.

HOUSEHOLD_ADDRESS.label: Household address cross-check
HOUSEHOLD_ADDRESS.mitigant: Confirm where the parent co-applicant lives; obtain address proof.

PAN.label: PAN number cross-check
PAN.mitigant: Correct the PAN in the lead or obtain the correct PAN card.

AADHAAR.label: Aadhaar number cross-check (last 4 digits)
AADHAAR.mitigant: Correct the Aadhaar number in the lead or obtain the correct Aadhaar.

PASSPORT_NO.label: Passport number cross-check
PASSPORT_NO.mitigant: Correct the passport number in the lead or obtain the correct passport copy.

DL_NO.label: Driving licence number cross-check
DL_NO.mitigant: Correct the licence number in the lead or obtain the correct licence copy.

VOTER_ID.label: Voter ID number cross-check
VOTER_ID.mitigant: Correct the voter ID in the lead or obtain the correct voter ID copy.

third_party.pan_link_condition: Aadhaar to be linked to PAN before disbursement

BUREAU_REPORT.label: Bureau report cross-check (mock)
BUREAU_REPORT.title: Bureau name, date of birth and address
BUREAU_REPORT.mitigant: Obtain affidavit / one-and-same-person declaration; correct manual bureau record.

FACE_MATCH.label: Face match check (mock)
FACE_MATCH.title: Face match (75% or more)
FACE_MATCH.mitigant: Critical: if face match is below 75%, the credit manager must justify it in OTHER REMARKS in the CAM.
